quest.title: On the Graffiti Road
quest.description: During this time, you've visited many places in Natlan to gather inspiration at Dopey Dazzler's suggestion, and you've learned a lot. It's time to report back to her...
quest.rewards_formatted: Dopey Dazzler's Notes on Graffiti x1, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Report your recent progress to Dopey Dazzler

dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: Judging by your looks, I assume you've seen some spots, gathered some materials, and found your inspiration?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... sorta? We certainly had fun along the way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Having a specific goal in mind helped us notice lots of details we wouldn't have before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This material-gathering project's been a real eye-opener for us, and we've come away with lots of samples too!

choices.text: Just a shame that we might not be able to use them all in our graffiti.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Oh, take your time, no rush! The whole point of the tour around Natlan was to help you realize what "avant-garde" is in the first place.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Speaking of which, mind telling me what you've seen and heard?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You show Dopey Dazzler the graffiti guidebook and the various photos you've taken...

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Hmm... Well. Aren't you the conscious photo-taker?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: I didn't expect you to be so experienced with Kameras as to subconsciously select excellent compositions for all these pictures.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: If anything, there's a danger I'll be stunting your growth if I say too much. Just a little guidance is all you'll need.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Please, take these notes of mine. Just give them a quick flick through when you encounter scenery on your journey. Perhaps they'll help you take pictures of even greater artistry!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. And here Paimon thought we'd be treated to a picture-by-picture analysis and... Y'know, avant-garde introductory lectures!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's also tempted to try doing some graffiti herself...

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: All the more reason to think that you're talented enough for self-driven learning!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: If anything, too much by-the-books learning might snuff that sort of potential out.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: As such, I think I need to adjust my role from responsible mentor to an assisting senior artist.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Just wait for a rush of inspiration at the opportune moment, then pick your paint jar up and show the world what you've got!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. We're that talented, are we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe... Looks like all the commissions we took from painters and film directors haven't gone to waste!

choices.text: My thanks for the compliments, then.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Relax! You'll get the hang of avant-garde aesthetics on your own in no time!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: I'm usually over in the Masters of the Night-Wind's lands, prepping for the construction of the Graffiti Alliance's headquarters. If you have any questions, feel free to head over and ask me.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: I'll be sure to kit you out with a fine set of graffiti-making implements next time you pop by!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice! So that's where your headquarters are going to be... We'll remember that. Best of luck!

choices.text: This was a pretty great time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's not forget to flick through Dopey Dazzler's notes when we're free. Can't do our artistic instincts any harm, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who knows, we might make a fortune from showing off our skills as graffiti grandmasters someday!

choices.text: We'll do our best to figure this out.
My avant-garde philosophy still needs some refinement.
